book.name: Malaka
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Malaka byex o

content: Yesu tiy memo veil moux ti
Xel la nge loxalu wei lounyeing Galili me la tembuing danghei wei xel Gerasa nei.
Gyeik Yesu lam myayaing veil bot, lutika eno moux tiwei laweeng nilaxes dei eivek e eno lam veil beyeeng wei meyeing o, me lam wou e.
Moux tine mindei eivek beyeeng wei meyeing o, xelti se teyeimbei tup e no, o se teyeimbei xel bako e nangya sen.
En e yon xel mi toung sen eivek e mema me vaxa, ekom moxo mi tax sen la yuw me pyaw aen mi pek lek vaxa. Xelti se ninkanzek teyei bei bong embo males.
Boukeing me bendiyeing eivek eeng wei meyeing me lukendu nayak senghoing, eno moxo mi eng ngandoung me ghuw xow angya qakous.
Gyeik e yei Yesu nanghei dingta, moxo veimya me la ev vaxa qatu eivek wou e manghalus.
Moxo ghak niseikeing bei, “Yesu, Anutu Neu wei gheyapu ghanaw veil o, wambei bong vati wou ay? Neil neing lek Anutu lei, bei tyek wa seng bong myaveweeng wou ay!”
En Yesu neil wou e woy bei, “Wa laweeng nilaxes on, lam myayaing veil moux tine!”
Woyom Yesu teling e, “Wa leim va?” Moxo neil elox, “A leing qendu ngandoung wei vevek, en inye xa ngenong.”
Om moxo tay wou Yesu lumama bei, e se bong xel na myayaing veil tembuing senghoing kayon.
Bok qendu ngandoung ti eno di ya paviy lukendu nayak on nenyawes.
Xel memo on tay wou Yesu bei, “Wong xa la eivek xel bok on.”

Moxo lenghek lek xel, om laweeng nilaxes on lam myayaing me la eivek bok. Bok qendu ngandoung on teyei lek ambei 2,000 eno veimyend niseikeing me la oing mazanghei me lepla eivek lounyeing me num memiing de mey.
Xel wei mi vet bok eno pek me la neil qayeeng tine eivek beyeeng nayak me beyeeng beimambei nei om xomaxoneing la myayaing bei na gyei vati wong tiyon.
Gyeik xel lam wou Yesu, xel yei moux tiwei memo ngenong mindei eivek e yo, eno byex teimb me e lupeyei yon yeip yaing, om xel yaleeng.
Eti yeiw wei xel yei eno neil wou xomaxoneing en vati wei belup wou moux wei memo mindei eivek o, me neil e lala en bok is ambei nyon.
Woyom xomaxoneing tay wou Yesu bei e na veil xel xe tembuing danghei tiyon.
Ka Yesu embei na eivek bot, moux wei memo dei eivek e yon lam tay wou Yesu bei na is e.
Yesu se lewexe lek e, qe neil, “La bam wou limyeiyeiw me neil wou xel, en vati wei Tambiy Ngandoung wong wou wang o, en ingwei lalei pyaxow en wang o.”
Om tambiy on la veil e me di neilteyei eivek tembuing danghei dalus wei Dekapolis nei en vati wei Yesu wong wou e yo. Om xomaxoneing dalus on etek en qayeeng on.
Vexawo wei mey me vex wei myavanei yo
Gyeik Yesu lox me la nge loxalu lek bot eivek lounyeing eno xomaxoneing qendu ngandoung qekuma me lam wou e gyeik e toungale paviy lounyeing o.
Woyom gyovaxa wei xomek qekueing ama eno ti lei Yairus, lam inyon. Yei Yesu, om moxo ev vaxa qatu eivek wou e vaxa,
me tay wou e, “A neung vex yak eno e bim a mey, om lam liw memam lek vexo en kandek e xe vanei e ma dom mendei mapieing.”
Om Yesu la is e. Xel qendu ngandoung ti betiwou e me vingama vivekwou e.
Me vex ti mindei inyon, eno e xe gyand mi lam teyei lek vakovek qes xoumeeng yuw.
Vexo mi qou vanei ngenong wou dokta ngenong me saing malew dalus wei e yo, ekom vanei yon se ma qe mi wo nol wou e.
Gyeik vexo ngo qayeeng en Yesu, vexo lam apu paviy e demi eivek xel qendu yon me axlek e xe teimb ding,
en vexo wounalei, “Wangwei a mou daxlek e xe teimb, tyek a bong nimzalek.”
Lutika eno vexo gyand touk me vexo axe lek xow bei wo nimzalek veil myavanei wei mi qou yo.
Lutika eno Yesu woulek bei nikanzek valu la veil e. Moxo pekwi ma vivekwou eivek xel qendu ngandoung on me teling, “Eti axlek a xe teimb?”
E xe xel betiyeing neil elox, “Wang wei xomaxoneing qendu ngandoung on nale lip is wang on, om nambei nya wang teling, ‘Eti axlek ay?’ ”
Ekom Yesu vena di yei e vivekwou bei gyei bei eti ka wong inye.
Woyom vex on vena woulek vati wei tyip wou e yo, om lam me ev vaxa qatu me yeip ma eivek tembuing me etek is yalenyeing, dom neil wou e zonghek en lul dalus.
Moxo neil wou vex on, “A neung vex, wa xe wongeingis wong wang wo nimzalek. La is laleim vevopeing. Vanei wei wang qou yo eno ma dom wang wo nimzalek.”
Ka Yesu nanghei di luk, moux valu lam anghei Yairus xe xomek, inyon gyovaxa wei xomek qekueing ama yo. Xel neil, “Wa neum vex eno mey, wa seng bo nimaying ti wou Putoung no.”
Yesu se li nenya wou vati wei xel neil o, qe neil wou gyovaxa wei xomek qekueing ama yo, “Wa seng gwaleeng. Qe wang bongis.”
Moxo se wong xelti betiwou e qe Petele, Jems me Yoan wei Jems li moux o.
Gyeik xel lam xomek wei gyovaxa wei xomek qekueing ama yo, Yesu yei xomaxoneing di wo nindenduing is engeing me di wo talot.
Moxo eivek la lalei me neil wou xel, “Nambei nya xam ghe di eng me ghe wong nindenduing ngandoung on enva? Vex yak ne mou se mey ti qe di yeip o.”
Ekom xel napexe e. Ka e tiy xel dalus la myayaing, eno qou vex yak on ma me ta me e xe betiyeing wei la is e yo me xel la eivek ingwei vex yak on di yeip anghei yo.
E zeim vexo mema dom neil wou vexo, “Talita kum,” qes ambei nye, “Vex yak, a neil wou wang, qandi lek!”
De lutika eno vex on nale ghey me vivek eivek xomek. En inye vex on xe vakovek qes xoumeeng yuw. Om xel on etek niseikeing.
Moxo wong petieing tine bei xel se bong xelti boulek inye, me neil wou xel bei xel bong lul yaeing valu wou vexo bei e gya.
